title: The king wanted a perfect castle

lines.tts: [storytelling] A king wanted the perfect castle. A peasant built a hut first. Guess who had a roof that winter?
lines.text: A king wanted the perfect castle. A peasant built a hut first. Guess who had a roof that winter?

lines.tts: [pompous, grand] Forty towers! Golden gates! A moat... with swans!
lines.text: Forty towers! Golden gates! A moat... with swans!

lines.tts: [dry] Year one: plans. Year two: more plans.
lines.text: Year one: plans. Year two: more plans.

lines.tts: Wren needed a bed. So she built one small room. Wobbly... but it worked.
lines.text: Wren needed a bed. So she built one small room. Wobbly... but it worked.

lines.tts: [building] Roof leaked? Fixed. Too cold? Fireplace. Every month, a little better.
lines.text: Roof leaked? Fixed. Too cold? Fireplace. Every month, a little better.

lines.tts: [ominous] Then winter came. The king's castle? Still a drawing.
lines.text: Then winter came. The king's castle? Still a drawing.

lines.tts: [shivering, quiet] ...Is there room in the hut?
That's an MVP. Build small, learn from real use, keep improving.
lines.text: That's an MVP. Build small, learn from real use, keep improving.

lines.tts: [smug, friendly] Two gold coins. Per night.
